summary: Source-anchored research for Percona PMM mongolog query source. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Both PMM setup and Operator documentation warn that moving or renaming active log files can interrupt mongolog collection. Validate rotation behavior when diagnosing missing QAN data. (high confidence)

Interpret Percona’s identical-analytics wording as feature/data comparability, not guaranteed identical operation coverage. This inference follows because level-2 profiling captures all operations, whereas normal diagnostic logging follows a threshold and sample rate; filters can further change selection. (high confidence)

Mongolog can run with profiling mode off. Do not infer identical operation coverage: level-2 profiling records all operations, whereas slow-log collection follows configured logging selection. (high confidence)
PMM documents mongolog support for mongos; MongoDB cannot enable its database profiler on mongos, although diagnostic slow-operation logging remains available. (high confidence)
Mongolog requires file-based slow-operation logging, MongoDB write access to its log file, PMM Agent read access, and appropriate database privileges. (low confidence)

A June 2, 2026 user report on PMM Server/Client 3.7.1 describes getCmdLineOpts failing during slow WiredTiger recovery, followed by STARTING → STOPPING → DONE without retry. This is an unconfirmed version-specific report, not proof of a current defect. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-02)

Datadog independently documents collecting MongoDB slow operations from system.profile when profiling is enabled, or via getLog when disabled. Its warning about a 1,024-event getLog buffer belongs to that API-based collector and must not be assigned to PMM’s file-tailing mongolog source. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Log collection can run with operationProfiling.mode: off and a configured slowOpThresholdMs. MongoDB must write to a file and PMM Agent must be able to read it. Disabling system.profile collection does not disable diagnostic slow-operation logging. (high confidence)

Percona attributes reduced connection contention to reading files instead of querying databases for QAN. This scopes the benefit to query collection; it does not establish that all PMM components need zero connections or that logging has zero server cost. (high confidence)

PMM mongolog reads MongoDB diagnostic log files for QAN; the profiler source instead reads per-database system.profile collections. An analytics interface therefore need not depend on enabling the database profiler. (high confidence)

Select log collection with pmm-admin add mongodb --query-source=mongolog. The command reference lists profiler as the default, with mongolog and none as alternatives. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)
Official release notes introduce mongolog in PMM 3.3.0, released July 9, 2025; a forum reply naming 3.2.0 conflicts with that primary release record. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-09)
Mongolog avoids continuous profiler polling, but still connects at startup to discover the log path; its documented privileges include clusterMonitor or getCmdLineOpts. (high confidence)

Operator issue 2363 reports open /data/db/mongod.log: no such file or directory with PMM3 on Operator 1.21.2, and working mongolog collection after 1.22.0 mounted the data PVC. Treat this as reporter-tested evidence, not a universal upgrade guarantee. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-05-28)
Percona's July 23, 2026 Operator 1.23.0 announcement lists choosing mongolog as a QAN source under K8SPSMDB-1546. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-23)

PMM distinguishes stored QAN for completed queries from real-time analytics for running operations. Selecting mongolog changes the stored-query input source; it does not itself provide an in-flight operation view. (high confidence)

PMM 3.3.0, released July 9, 2025, introduced mongolog as an alternative query source intended to reduce monitoring connection pressure in deployments with many databases. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-09)

Operator 1.23.1 documentation says mongolog support was added in Operator 1.23.0, requires PMM 3.3.0 or newer, and needs logcollector enabled so PMM can read logs under /data/db/logs/; select it with spec.pmm.querySource: mongolog. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-10)
